difficulty_reason: The Littlewood--Richardson rule is a prerequisite; the residual task is a uniform construction of two distinct equal-content ballot tableaux for arbitrary four-column endpoint configurations using at most rho+1 symbols. The twelve relative-length/order regimes require simultaneous column strictness, ballot control and a cross-pair row bound, whose two exceptional cases are excluded by the original shortness-one hypotheses. General shapes also require the rho-controlled column-transfer statement and the authors' six-case three-column fallback, rather than the computation of a single LR coefficient.
